description: Export the active document to PDF using a named PDF export preset in one call — validates the preset first and, if it is wrong, fails with the list of valid preset names

documentIndex.description: Index into the open-document list (see document_getState); defaults to the front document

document_id.description: Which open document to act on: a name (see document_listOpen) or a 0-based index. Defaults to the front document.

filePath.description: Absolute path of the PDF to write

presetName.description: Name of an existing PDF export preset, e.g. "[Press Quality]" — the error lists the valid names

name: recipe_exportPreset
